why: Cuts the cloud to blocked-fire-muzzle.ts's own 0.07s. Duration is the property the owner's original request turns on -- smoke lingers, a flash does not -- so a puff gone in a frame and a half is a grey flash whatever its texture says. It matters more since #536 than it did as an arm: a refusal is now told apart by how its smoke looks, and there is no looking at something that has already gone. Pinned as a BOUND rather than an exact value, since the number is feel: the tests ask only that the puff outlive the flash several times over and still end.
killedBy: muzzle smoke (issue #536, parent #356) drifts off the barrel and rises, and outlives the flash several times over
